Question_text: The percentage by mass of iron in steel can be determined by converting all the iron in the steel into aqueous iron(II) ions and titrating portions of the solution with aqueous potassium manganate(VII).
You are provided with solution R and solid S. Carry out the following tests and record your observations in the table. You should test and name any gas evolved.
